profile.title: UI/UX Designer • Computer Science & Design Student
profile.tagline: Designing digital experiences that are intuitive, engaging and meaningful.
profile.alternativeHero: Good design isn't just how it looks. It's how it works, feels and connects.
bioParagraphs: I'm Krish Patel, a Computer Science and Design student passionate about UI/UX design and creating meaningful digital experiences.

I enjoy transforming ideas into visually engaging and intuitive interfaces. My interests include interface design, wireframing, prototyping, visual storytelling and creating user-friendly digital products.
With a background in computer science, I also understand the technical side of digital products, allowing me to connect design thinking with practical implementation.
I'm continuously learning, experimenting with design tools and building projects to improve my creative and technical skills.

projects.title: Thrift Avenue
projects.subtitle: A sustainable fashion mobile commerce concept focused on circular clothing and community-driven thrifting.
projects.description: A thrift fashion brand concept developed as a comprehensive UI/UX and visual branding project. Includes brand identity, logo design, brochure design, email design, design research, user personas, and high-fidelity mobile app UI.

fullCaseStudy.overview: Thrift Avenue was conceptualized to address the lack of intuitive, trustworthy platforms for second-hand vintage fashion enthusiasts in India. The goal was to eliminate the clutter of traditional marketplace apps by introducing an editorial, curated shopping experience.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Second-hand apparel platforms often feel disorganized and unpolished. Users struggle with sizing ambiguities, trust verification, and inefficient search filters.
fullCaseStudy.research: Conducted interviews with 15 vintage clothing shoppers aged 18-28. Key insights revealed that 82% wanted aesthetic item storytelling and verified seller ratings over generic product catalogs.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Created an immersive mobile interface in Figma featuring swipeable moodboard-style lookbooks, interactive size comparison guides, and a seamless 3-tap checkout flow.
features: Curated visual discovery feed with dynamic category filters
Interactive size estimation and condition transparency badges
Seller authenticity profiles with verified customer reviews
Direct chat & offer negotiation with responsive notifications
Cohesive visual branding including custom logo, iconography, and typography
fullCaseStudy.results: Produced over 45 high-fidelity screens, an interactive Figma prototype with 100+ transitions, and a complete design system adhering to 8pt grid standards.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Reinforced the importance of micro-interactions and negative space in elevating a bargain/thrift product into a premium retail experience.

projects.title: Smart Hire
projects.subtitle: An intelligent, AI-assisted recruitment portal connecting candidates and recruiters through structured screening.
projects.description: A job recruitment platform designed to connect candidates and recruiters through a structured hiring process with candidate portal, recruiter dashboard, resume parsing, anonymous screening, and AI-based rejection feedback.

fullCaseStudy.overview: Smart Hire bridges the communication gap between aspiring talent and talent acquisition teams by providing transparent real-time tracking, unbiased screening, and actionable AI feedback.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Recruiters are overwhelmed by unstructured PDF resumes, while applicants suffer from lack of feedback and implicit bias during early resume reviews.
fullCaseStudy.research: Benchmarked popular portals (LinkedIn, Indeed) to discover pain points: applicants felt ghosted after rejections, and recruiters spent under 6 seconds per resume skimming without automated sorting.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Designed an intuitive dual-portal interface (Candidate & Recruiter) paired with automated skill-based matching and automated constructive feedback.
features: Candidate portal with one-click resume upload (PDF/DOC)
Recruiter dashboard with pipeline stages (Applied, Screening, Interview, Offer)
Anonymous application mode to prevent demographic bias
AI-driven constructive feedback for rejected applicants
Real-time application status notifications via Socket.io
Advanced job search with salary, location, and tech stack filters
fullCaseStudy.results: Designed end-to-end Figma UI/UX and integrated with a React.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB backend with JWT authentication.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Gained deep insights into complex dashboard information architecture and designing for high-density analytical screens.

projects.title: GourmetGo
projects.subtitle: A delightful culinary delivery app designed around visual appetite appeal and effortless cart customization.
projects.description: A modern food-related UI/UX design project exploring micro-interactions, high-contrast meal photography, dynamic menu exploration, and rapid delivery tracking.

fullCaseStudy.overview: GourmetGo re-imagines food ordering by emphasizing visual dish presentation, dietary ingredient badges, and live kitchen preparation updates.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Most food apps cram excessive text and advertisements, distracting hungry users from finding what they crave.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Employed bold typography, vibrant photography, card-based category browsing, and an interactive dish modifier bottom-sheet in Figma.
features: Visual-first dish cards with dietary labels (Vegan, Gluten-Free, Keto)
Interactive meal customization sheet with live pricing recalculation
Animated checkout progress and real-time courier radar tracking
Dark-mode friendly interface with warm appetizing color accents
fullCaseStudy.results: Created a 30-screen interactive Figma prototype with animated components and micro-interactions.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Mastered Figma auto-layout, nested component variants, and interactive prototype states.

projects.title: Soundix
projects.subtitle: An immersive music streaming application with dynamic ambient player visuals and spatial audio customization.
projects.description: An audio and music-related design project focusing on dark-mode aesthetic immersion, audio waveform visualizations, dynamic playlist curation, and fluid gesture navigation.

fullCaseStudy.overview: Soundix was crafted for audiophiles and music lovers seeking a minimalist, distraction-free player with ambient background colors matching album cover art.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Balancing high information density (lyrics, queuing, audio quality toggles) with an uncluttered visual aesthetic.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Designed a gesture-first player interface where the background subtly adapts to album colors with blur mesh shaders and smooth GSAP-inspired transitions.
features: Ambient blurred artwork backdrop dynamically responding to music tracks
Interactive scrubbing waveform with timestamp previews
Time-synced floating lyrics viewer
Curated mood discovery stations and collaborative session queueing
fullCaseStudy.results: High-fidelity Figma UI design praised for its typography hierarchy and slick dark glassmorphism.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Learned advanced color theory and designing high-contrast interfaces for low-light environments.

projects.title: Nike Air Concept
projects.subtitle: A high-energy sneaker e-commerce concept with 3D product inspection and editorial streetwear aesthetics.
projects.description: A sneaker-related design project combining bold brutalist typography, dynamic product angles, interactive colorway selector, and high-impact micro-animations.

fullCaseStudy.overview: An experimental concept exploring how high-fashion sneaker drops can feel like an interactive digital exhibition rather than a standard online shop.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Creating excitement for limited product releases while maintaining intuitive cart and sizing usability.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Integrated oversized display lettering, interactive 360-degree rotation placeholders, and bold sticky purchase bar.
features: Immersive hero section with diagonal grid cuts and dynamic typography
Interactive colorway and size selector with real-time stock indicators
Storytelling section detailing materials and design inspiration
Instant one-click checkout with animated confirmation
fullCaseStudy.results: Editorial concept showcasing strong visual design and typography mastery.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Practiced asymmetric layout compositions and modern luxury streetwear web aesthetics.

projects.title: Brew Haven
projects.subtitle: An artisanal coffee brand experience celebrating craft roasting and mindful cafe ordering.
projects.description: A specialty coffee brand and design project encompassing logo design, packaging identity, coffee bean roast selector, and interactive cafe ordering interface.

fullCaseStudy.overview: Brew Haven brings the warmth and aroma of artisanal coffee culture to a tactile, beautifully designed digital ordering experience.
fullCaseStudy.challenge: Communicating subtle flavor profiles (notes of citrus, dark chocolate, hazelnut) through visual digital cues.
fullCaseStudy.solution: Used warm earthy color palettes, custom iconography for brewing methods (Pour Over, French Press, Espresso), and a taste profile radar chart.
features: Artisanal bean subscription configurator with custom grind choices
Roast profile visualization with acidity and body gauges
Pick-up time scheduler for local cafe branches
Cohesive visual branding across cups, packaging, and digital app
fullCaseStudy.results: Complete branding kit and high-fidelity prototype in Figma.
fullCaseStudy.learnings: Refined visual storytelling and emotional design principles.
